input.source:
SERVICE ADDENDUM

1. Retention
Customer records are retained for 24 months after the end of the subscription.
Backups are deleted within 90 days.

2. Termination
The customer may terminate with 60 days notice.
Termination for convenience does not trigger a refund.

3. Support
Support is available on business days only.
Emergency support is available for 24 hours a day.
input.summary:
This addendum governs the subscription service.
The customer may terminate with 60 days notice.
Termination for convenience does not trigger a refund.

cases.rationale: The brief asks about retention. The 24-month retention obligation is exactly on point and the summary drops it.
